note: My Own Private Idaho (Van Sant) + Tarkovsky's The Killers dramatize Hingehaltenheit/Leergelassenheit as waiting, clock-watching, and failed Zeitvertreib (FE).
The Dead (Huston/Joyce) + Hour of the Wolf (Bergman): the pastime becomes coextensive with the occasion itself, producing an extended present and Unheimlichkeit (FE).
White Nights (Visconti/Dostoevsky) stages 'es ist einem langweilig' on an anonymous Sunday afternoon where no pastime is even possible (FE).

Zeitvertreib etymology ('driving time along'), clock-checking as symptom of failed pastime, and the kairological Augenblick contrasted with chronological time (FAITHFUL-HERNÁNDEZ ALBARRACÍN, pp.204-206, 214-216).
Modern technological/entertainment 'overflow' is diagnosed as producing meaninglessness while marketing itself as escape from boredom (FE).

Rejects the causal-psychological model that treats mood as an internal state with a specific external cause, 'to be analyzed psychologically... to determine the factors that forged [a] neurosis' (FE, p.195).
Distinguishes 'aburrimiento' from 'aburribilidad' (boringness) to resist any state/trait causal framing of mood entirely; aburribilidad is ontological-structural, not diagnosable (FE).
The Bergman dinner-party pastime is itself shown relapsing into boredom rather than escaping it, complicating any simple engagement/boredom binary (FE).
Clock-checking and 'looking toward nothing in particular' gesture at attentional disengagement, though undertheorized relative to cognitive-science treatments (FE).
The White Nights stroller's diffuse, near-invisible observation of the anonymous crowd on a silent Sunday (FE).

First form (being-bored-by) is explicated by fcm-04's train-station/Zeitvertreib apparatus; this source's film pair (My Own Private Idaho, The Killers) is an illustrative gloss substituting road/bar for station, not a re-argument of FCM's own structure (P/anticipatory-application).

Second form (being-bored-with) — this source's party-scene films (The Dead, Hour of the Wolf) map onto fcm-05's Sichlangweilen bei etwas, where the pastime dissolves into the occasion itself (P/anticipatory-application).
Third form (es ist einem langweilig) — this source's White Nights reading maps onto fcm-06's profound boredom and its total refusal of beings-as-a-whole (P/anticipatory-application).

This source's own framing thesis — Langweiligkeit as the Grundstimmung of our era — directly restates fcm-07's subject matter, 'a particular profound boredom' as the fundamental attunement of contemporary Dasein, though never cited by FCM section number (P/anticipatory-application).
Cites Escudero (2007, 2014) on affects stigmatized since Plato/Descartes and on the epochal-Grundstimmung claim that being manifests through moods such as dread, joy, or boredom.
Cites Svendsen's Filosofía del tedio on Kierkegaard's account of tedium, on transparency/extremity in modern entertainment, and on clock-watching as the proclamation of failed pastime.
Cites Löwith on the demand that 'man remember himself' and on resolute selfhood as authentic self-sameness opposed to das Man.
Cites Held on the fundamental attunement disclosing the totality of one's historical situation and on Dasein's potentiality-for-being (Seinkönnen).
Invokes Foucault's 'cuidado de sí' (self-care) register from the Rux Martin interview to gloss authentic self-relation against das Man's public discourse.
Invokes the Tractatus's 'world of the happy is different from the world of the unhappy' as a relational analogue for mood-constituted worldhood, against subjectivized readings of mood.
My Own Private Idaho's opening road scene and Tarkovsky's Killers bar scene furnish concrete images of Hingehaltenheit and failed Zeitvertreib (the repeated clock-check).
Huston's The Dead (post-party emptiness sensed only afterward) and Bergman's Hour of the Wolf (the castle dinner) furnish concrete images of Sichlangweilen bei etwas.
Visconti's White Nights (the anonymous Sunday-afternoon stroller newly arrived in the city) furnishes the concrete image of es ist einem langweilig.

Cites Mendieta Rodríguez (2019) on the anonymous bored observer and on chronic ennui as a literary/cinematic topos, drawing a parallel to that author's own study of La grande bellezza (Sorrentino, 2013).

Co-author self-cites his 2012 study of Langeweile in Alejandra Pizarnik's poetry and his 2016 Heidegger-to-Morin complexity study to underwrite the 'aporía de la existencia' framing and prior work on boredom.

Co-author self-cites his 2018 doctoral dissertation on autonomous weapons systems as the originating source of the 'desbordamiento tecnológico' (technological overflow) concept applied here to boredom.

Closes with Vattimo's account of Heidegger as 'polarized' between attention to individual experience (anxiety, death, care) and belonging to world-as-totality, framing declared future work on solitude and finitude.
Quotes Yannis Ritsos's poem on the indifferent passer-by (≤12 words) to figure technology's blank passing-by of the very Dasein it overflows.
